Approach ACKed serial request processing and suggested socket timeout for test
benchmarked and raised concern over a ~50ms latency floor introduced on keep-alive RPC calls

claims.harm: introduces a ~50ms latency floor on keep-alive RPC requests because WaitMany is not re-armed when a request finishes
claims.quote: Benchmarked keep-alive RPC latency on Linux (regtest, Python http.client, synchronous client). All busy sockets run in one tick, but per-connection latency has a ~50ms floor.

support.reason: in order to keep request processing strictly serial, as intended in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/35735#issue-4901039304, it makes sense to stop pipelining requests or reading requests ahead

waiting_on.what: address ~50ms keep-alive RPC latency regression identified in benchmarks

result.notes: Added 151henry151's benchmark-backed objection regarding a ~50ms latency floor added to keep-alive RPC requests due to un-signaled event loop wakeups.
